t: Lightweight but sturdy mitre saw stand with extension arms. Quick to assemble, foldable legs make the stand easy to pack away and transport, while the height-adjustable arms are able to support workpieces up to 2m in length. Quick-release mounting brackets allow the removal of tools quickly and also ensure the stand is compatible with almost every make of mitre saw. Rollers and end-stops keep everything in the right place while in use. Adjustable foot can be balanced on uneven surfaces. Integrated material stops so that repetitive cuts can be made quickly and accurately.
